Title: Ajay's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Ajay - 29 years, son
Look: white kurta-pyjama
2. Anjali - 65 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Manoj - 29 years, friend
Look: glasses, brown sweater
4. Pallavi - 31 years, daughter
Look: green saree

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Ajay stands by the road. Anjali and Pallavi stand near him.]

Ajay: "What lovely weather!"

[Ajay rides his motorbike to the market.]

Ajay: "That's easy."

[Ajay starts his scooter and rides off.]

Ajay (gently): "That's great!"

[Ajay drives the car to the office.]

Anjali: "I'm ready!"

[Ajay gets out of the car.]

Ajay: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
